name: Suno Studio
desc: Generative audio workstation for editing and extending Suno songs
desc_zh: 生成式音频工作站，编辑和延展 Suno 歌曲
solves: A generated song was a take-it-or-leave-it file; Studio lets you split stems, swap parts and arrange them.
solves_zh: 以前生成的歌只能整首接受或放弃；Studio 可以拆分轨、换声部、重新编排。
best_for: The second verse of your Suno track should be instrumental; open Studio, mute the vocal stem there and extend.
best_for_zh: Suno 曲子的第二段主歌想要纯伴奏；打开 Studio，把那段人声分轨静音并延长。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://suno.com/blog (post 'Introducing Suno Studio')）。 Outside the window but absent from the ledger. Studio 2.0 followed on 2026-08-13 ('Studio 2.0 is now available to Suno Premier subscribers.') and is the same product, so the first-release date is kept. Premier-only at launch. Second source is the vendor's own later post. 首次公开日期来源：https://suno.com/blog/suno-studio 官网未直接确认（redirect->https://suno.com/studio-welcome）。
